scope_note: V1's original SAGE real-world, 2,265-image off-taxonomy, and Sugarcane-OOD test sets could NOT be replicated for V2 -- the delivered AgriMind-ML-Evaluation.zip contains only V1's prediction CSVs for those tests, not the underlying source images (verified this session: only 07_Manual_Test/test_corn_rust.jpg is an actual image file anywhere in that archive). This OOD evaluation instead uses real, license-verified PlantVillage images from four crops/diseases outside V2-alpha's own taxonomy (Tomato Bacterial Spot, Tomato Late Blight, Apple Black Rot, Grape Black Rot) as a genuine real-image OOD set, plus 100 synthetic non-plant images. This is NOT the same test V1 was scored against, so V1-vs-V2 OOD numbers are NOT directly comparable -- see docs/ml_v2_ood_report.md for the full honest comparison caveat.
id_set: V2-alpha internal held-out test split (659 images, Corn/Potato)

ood_real_plant_set.source: PlantVillage GitHub mirror (CC BY-SA 3.0), classes never included in V2-alpha training

ood_noise_set.composition: 25 each of: pure random noise, solid color, half-split block, linear gradient

threshold_calibration.calibrated_on: validation split only (never test or OOD data)
threshold_calibration.confidence_threshold_meaning: reject if max softmax confidence < this value (5th percentile of val confidences)
threshold_calibration.mahalanobis_threshold_meaning: reject if embedding distance > this value (95th percentile of val distances)

interpretation: AUROC of 0.5 = no better than chance at separating ID from OOD; 1.0 = perfect separation. FPR95 = the false-positive rate (ID images wrongly rejected) when the threshold is set to catch 95% of true OOD images -- lower is better. See docs/ml_v2_ood_report.md for which method (if either) is recommended, chosen from these measured numbers, not assumed.
